_comment: Request-guard mutation table (issue #75) — run it from the workspace root:
The command is scoped to tests/test_request_guard.py, so CAUGHT means a
guard test caught it; exit-code reporting names no individual test, which
is why the scoping is done by file rather than with 'expect'.
The last entry is a CONTROL that MUST be MISSED.

mutations.label: the marker-header requirement is dropped (text/plain CSRF reaches /install)
Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site is no longer refused in the pack
loopback trust ignores the Host header (DNS rebinding gets install)
a request with no Host header loses loopback trust
CONTROL: docstring prose no test can see
mutations.before: """Decorate a state-changing route so _csrf_refusal runs before its body."""
mutations.after: """Wrap a state-changing route so _csrf_refusal runs before its body."""
